# Notes Wall · 便签墙
A sticky-notes wall pinned to the DSH sidebar: click the icon, capture the thought, keep going.
挂在 DSH 左侧栏的一面便签墙：随手写下想法、灵感和待办，停笔即存。
## What it does / 功能
- **Sidebar entry + full page.** The plugin registers an icon in `sidebar.panellist` (order `12`) an
d a panel page on the `main` slot under its own `notes-wall` key — it never takes over the conversat

ion panel.
- **Write where you see it.** Every note is a live textarea; text is saved 240 ms after y

ou stop typing.
- **Six paper colors**, a real pin for the ones that matter, and a two-step delete (

auto-cancels after 4.5 s).
- **Tags without a tag field.** Type `#插件` inside a note and it becomes a
tag. The toolbar grows a filter chip per tag (sorted by usage); clicking a chip or the pill on a no
te filters the wall. Tags are parsed from the text, so editing the text edits the tag and exported f

iles need no migration.
- **Search** across note bodies, `Esc` clears it.
- **Export / import** as J

SON; duplicate ids are renumbered on import.
- **Empty notes clean themselves up** — a note with no

text disappears when it loses focus.
- **Local only.** Everything lives in `localStorage` under `dsh
.notes-wall.notes.v1`. Nothing is uploaded, nothing enters the session, and the Host half is an empt
notes.v1`. Nothing is uploaded, nothing enters the session, and the Host half is an empty `apply()`.
便签纸的颜色是「内容」（artwork）；页面、工具栏、按钮、空态全部走宿主主题 token `--dsw-alias-*`，跟随明暗主题。
## Install / 安装
The package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so it is installable like any DSH plugin:

1. Plugin Manager — install from this folder (or from the GitHub repo once published).
2. Or, from a

checkout: `dsh plugin add <path-or-git-url>`.
3. Or, straight from GitHub: `dsh plugin add https://
github.com/EchoTint/dsh-notes-wall`.
After the first install (and after every edit to `client.js`), **restart DSH** so the new JS generat
ion is loaded; then refresh the page and the notebook icon appears in the sidebar.
## Keyboard / 键盘
| Keys | Action |

| `⌘ / Ctrl + Enter` | Pin a new blank note (also available from the toolbar) |
| `Esc` | Close the
color palette, or blur the note (an empty note is then dropped) |

## Development notes / 开发注意
- The client half is plain JS wrapped in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) {...}

})` — **no JSX**, build elements with `React.createElement` (aliased to `h`).
- Only host modules su
ch as `require('react')` are available. Do **not** require `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` o

r any other Harness Client package; every icon here is hand-drawn SVG.
- All visible text goes throu

gh `ctx.locale.register` / `bind`, and the zh/en dictionaries must keep exactly the same keys.
- Sty
les are injected via `ctx.effect` into `<style data-dsh-notes-wall>` and removed in the cleanup; cla

ss names are prefixed `.nw-`.
- Offline self-test: `node ../../.dsh-asar/notes-wall-stub.cjs` — it r
enders the real component tree on a miniature React, and asserts registration, rendering, edit persi
stence, tag filtering and pill clicks, empty-note disposal, and locale key parity.
